question: Who is considered as the person responsible for the political integration of India by unifying 562 princely states in the country?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vallabhbhai Jhaverbhai Patel**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel is considered the person responsible for the political integration of India by unifying 562 princely states in the country.
 
• He was a prominent figure in the Indian Freedom Struggle and the first Deputy Prime Minister and Home Minister of India. 
 
• National unity and integrity
 
• Patel's commitment to national unity and integrity was a key factor in persuading princely states to join the Indian Union. 
 
• Bardoli Satyagraha
 
• Patel became famous throughout the country after the Bardoli Satyagraha of 1928, which earned him the title of "Sardar". 
 
• Non-Cooperation Movement
 
• Patel joined Gandhi's Non-Cooperation Movement in 1920 and recruited 300,000 members. 
 
• Patel is also known as the "Iron Man of India". His birth anniversary is celebrated as National Unity Day or Rashtriya Ekta Diwas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Subhas Chandra Bose
 
• A revolutionary leader who founded the Indian National Army and is known by the title "Netaji".
 
• His famous slogans include "Give me blood, and I shall give you freedom!" and "Jai Hind". 
 
• Jawaharlal Nehru
 
• Born in Allahabad in 1889, he led the country under the Indian National Congress. In 1938, he established the National Planning Committee to create an economic strategy for the country. 
 
• Lal Bahadur Shastri
 
• Served as India's second Prime Minister from 1964 to 1966.
